import itertools
# regions over 4 sets G,C,F,V: each of 16 regions empty/non-empty
regs=list(itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4))
I_always=True; II_always=True; n=0
for mask in range(1<<16):
    R=[regs[i] for i in range(16) if mask>>i&1]
    if not R: continue
    if any(g and not c for g,c,f,v in R): continue
    if not any(c and f for g,c,f,v in R): continue
    if any(f and v for g,c,f,v in R): continue
    if not any(g for g,c,f,v in R): continue
    n+=1
    # I: all cereals can be vegetables -> possible to make every cereal a vegetable: fails if some cereal is fruit
    I=not any(c and f for g,c,f,v in R)
    II=all(f for g,c,f,v in R if g)
    I_always&=I; II_always&=II
res={(False,False):'B',(True,False):'A',(False,True):'C',(True,True):'D'}[(I_always,II_always)]
assert n>0 and res=='B'
for k in 'ACD': assert res!=k

import itertools
# regions over (grain,cereal,fruit,veg) as subsets; brute force models
T=[t for t in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4)]
def models():
    for k in range(1,2**len(T)):
        S=[T[i] for i in range(len(T)) if k>>i&1]
        if all(g<=c for g,c,f,v in S) and any(c and f for g,c,f,v in S) and not any(f and v for g,c,f,v in S):
            yield S
I=lambda S:all((not c) or v for g,c,f,v in S)
II=lambda S:all((not g) or f for g,c,f,v in S)
import random
random.seed(1)
Ms=[]
for S in models():
    Ms.append(S)
    if len(Ms)>3000:break
nI=all(I(S) for S in Ms);nII=all(II(S) for S in Ms)
assert not nI and not nII
ans={'A':nI and not nII,'B':not nI and not nII,'C':nII and not nI,'D':nI and nII}
assert [k for k,v in ans.items() if v]==['B']
steps: Some cereals are fruits, fruits are not vegetables -> I false
Grains need not be fruits -> II false
